articles.title: Ethiopia and Tigray accuse each of launching offensives, fuelling fears of new war
articles.description: The local authorities reportedly seize Tigray's airports following reports of recent drone strikes.

articles.title: Azerbaijan pardons Frenchman after EU lifts sanctions on Russian billionaire
articles.description: Martin Ryan is pardoned months after he was jailed on charges of spying, but a second Frenchman remains in prison.

articles.title: South Sudan's president dissolves government ahead of country's first elections
articles.description: South Sudan has not held elections since independence in 2011 - polls have twice been postponed.

articles.title: US to build two military bases in Greenland under new deal with Denmark
articles.description: The defence deal signed at the UN General Assembly also re-affirms Denmark's sovereignty over its semi-autonomous Arctic territory.

articles.title: Ukraine anger as EU removes Russian oligarchs from sanctions list
articles.description: Alisher Usmanov and Mikhail Fridman both have close ties to President Putin, and Kyiv said the move sent Moscow the wrong signals.

articles.title: How Ceuta, football and Israel are shaping Morocco's election
articles.description: Young voters are being courted with football slogans, promises of jobs and anti-Israel rallying calls.

articles.title: Fifteen jailed for life over involvement in Sri Lanka attacks that killed more than 260
articles.description: Fifteen men have been convicted for their involvement in the 2019 Easter Sunday bombings which killed more than 260 people in Sri Lanka.

articles.title: Doctors warn of 'exponential' rise in e-scooter and scrambler bike injuries
articles.description: Injuries related to e-scooters and scrambler motorbikes in Ireland are rising at an "exponential rate" and "stretching" an already overstretched system, experts have warned.
